title: Fixed positive rational common beta kernels
scope: A single fixed pole-free rational K on [0,1], with a positive lower bound and relevant beta moments in Q + Q pi with nonzero pi coefficient; both matching signs and any infinite even-index set.
conclusion: The primitive integer-form magnitude diverges after the complete gcd.
not_excluded: Variable kernels, different weights and nonrational kernels are outside the theorem.

title: Fixed sign-changing rational common beta kernels
scope: A fixed pole-free rational kernel, the same beta weight, nonzero pi moment coefficient on the relevant infinite even set; kernel positivity is not assumed.
conclusion: Symmetrization, midpoint asymptotics, exponential coordinate height and complete matching content force primitive divergence.
not_excluded: An n-dependent kernel or a different construction is not excluded.

title: Degree-one matched Hermite–Padé: all even indices
scope: The literal (n,1,n) matched endpoint construction, actual completely reduced q_n, nonzero Delta, and all sufficiently large even n.
conclusion: Uniform prime-5/13 and dyadic denominator rates beat the complete endpoint error rate; every even subsequence fails primitive-error decay.
not_excluded: Odd indices, growing exponential degree and other endpoint constructions are not excluded.

title: Original raw diagonal family: all integer degrees
scope: The original raw family, actual Z and N=Pe(1)+4Pa(1), full g=gcd(|Z|,|N|), both parities and all sufficiently large integer degrees.
conclusion: The actual primitive whole integer error tends to infinity, with an explicit exponential-over-polynomial lower bound. No subsequence of this family yields decay.
not_excluded: This excludes this original family only. It does not decide rationality and does not transfer to another auxiliary.

title: Reflected two-pole repair in the n log n depth regime
scope: The actual reflected two-pole projection with all endpoint terms retained, n=4k, and h/(n log n) tending to a fixed kappa>0.
conclusion: The ordinary approximation center diverges to positive infinity, with the stated signed asymptotic.
not_excluded: Other growth laws, including the quadratic critical window, are outside this exclusion.

title: The separate original Laguerre matrix
scope: All original admissibility conditions for b=3^(249005515+574312172u), n=2001b, d=b-1, h=2000b+1; complete corrected matrix and actual all-prime g and q.
conclusion: The complete primitive error is greater than 1000 sqrt(b) pointwise on the admissible domain. Every unbounded admissible collection fails primitive-error decay.
not_excluded: This does not assert new infinitude of a constrained domain and does not exclude the compact mixed pencil, older prime-29 producer or continuing coordinate scratch.
